data.rationale: The contract clearly defines the deliverables (a Web & Social pack and master vector source files) and the client approved the final design on 2026‑06‑29. The freelancer sent a download link containing both required zip files on 2026‑07‑01, satisfying the contractual description. Delivery logs confirm the Web & Social pack was downloaded; the master vector zip was never downloaded before the link expired, which is why the client cannot use it for signage. Therefore the chargeback is unjustified, but the real issue is the missing master files, which can be resolved by re‑issuing the zip. No refund is owed under the non‑refundable fee clause.

strategy.rationale: The contract clearly defines the deliverables (a Web & Social pack and master vector source files) and the client approved the final design on 2026‑06‑29. The freelancer sent a download link containing both required zip files on 2026‑07‑01, satisfying the contractual description. Delivery logs confirm the Web & Social pack was downloaded; the master vector zip was never downloaded before the link expired, which is why the client cannot use it for signage. The contract also obligates the freelancer to re‑issue the Final Asset Package free of charge for 12 months. Therefore the chargeback is unjustified, but the real issue is the missing master files, which can be resolved by re‑issuing the zip. No refund is owed under the non‑refundable fee clause.

proof_plan.point: The service was described in the contract as a complete brand identity package including master vector source files
The freelancer delivered the Final Asset Package exactly as described in the contract
The client provided written approval of the final design, triggering acceptance under the contract
The client never downloaded the master vector files, which is why they claim the package is unusable for signage
Fees are non‑refundable after written approval, except when the Final Asset Package is not delivered; delivery was completed, so a refund is not justified
The contract obligates the freelancer to re‑issue the Final Asset Package within 2 business days upon request for 12 months after delivery

strategy.resolution_action: Re‑issue the missing master vector source files (Halden_Master_Vectors_and_Copyright.zip) to the client via a new secure download link within 2 business days, as required by §7.2 of the contract.
